implementation: Eight distinct wheel intents, one canonical page for each; number-range variants are presets on one number page.
Original visible, server-rendered definitions, instructions, examples, probability explanations and FAQs.
Unique titles and descriptions; WebApplication, BreadcrumbList and Article structured data on tools; CollectionPage and ItemList on the hub.
Internal links from homepage categories, discovery cards, directory, footer, search and sitemap.
No keyword meta tags, fabricated reviews, keyword-volume claims, special AI schema or hidden search-only copy.
Visible FAQs serve readers. No claim of Google FAQ rich results, which Google retired in 2026.
Existing environment-controlled indexing rules are preserved. Wheel pages are initially English; translated discovery links use their valid English canonical routes.
